item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #MINPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 17 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #DavaoOccidental, #DavaoDelSur, #DavaoOriental, #DavaoDelNorte, #DavaoDeOro, #DavaoCity, #MisamisOccidental, #MisamisOriental, #Camiguin, #LanaoDelNorte and #Bukidnon within 12 hours.
